place.source_title: US Coast Guard Station St. Joseph

brief: A small harbour Coast Guard station at the pier root: a white two-storey building with a red roof and a lookout, a patrol boat at the concrete pier in front of the white-and-red lighthouse. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the photo shows the St. Joseph MI pier and its inner pierhead light (a white steel lighthouse with a red roof on a concrete crib, an elevated catwalk along the pier) with a Coast Guard response boat; the station building itself is out of frame -- tokenize the setting, not the station

why.note: harbour entrances on the lakes are a pier, a pierhead light and a Coast Guard station
